༄༅// mdo khams yul gru 'ga' zhig tu gnas pa'i yul lha rnams la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga las/ thog mar gser dang ldan ma'i yul gyi gzhi bdag 'bar lha rtse rgyal 'khor dang bcas par bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dge mtshan yi ge'i gling bu bsgyur bas kyang*// 'byung po kun gyi khengs pa rgyang bskyur nas// zhabs rdul spyi bos bsten pa bla ma dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyis srid zhi'i bde legs stsol// gangs can lha gcig phyag na pad+ma yi// thugs rje'i gdugs dkar grib bsil ngal gso zhing*// rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs mi dman yul bdag lha// dgyes bskyed bsang mchod sprin gyi bzhad sgra 'byin// srid pa'i lha chen mchod pas thun mong gi /dngos grub bde blag ster ba de 'dra ni// rang stobs 'bad pa stong gis 'grub min na// gang phyir 'di la gus pa ci ste lhod// de'ang gser ldan dga' ma'i yul gyi gzhi bdag 'bar lha rtse rgyal 'khor bcas la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/ bsang mchod rgyas pa dang 'brel na des thus mod/ de lta min pa'i tshe dkar gtor zlum po la bya dang ri dwags la sogs pa gzugs 'gros sna tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ bsang rdzas mchod pa spyi ltar bshams te/ 'di skad do// kye tshad med mkhyen brtse nus gter bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun skyabs bzung nas// gtong ba chen po'i pha rol phyin slad du// mchod sbyin cho gar yang dag 'jug par bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ mgron spyan drang ba ni/ hrīḥbadag nyid 'phags mchog thugs rje che ldan sku// dkar gsal snang stong dbyer med zhi zhing sgeg /yid 'phrog rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i thugs ka nas// 'od zer lcags kyu'i pho nya grangs med spros// gser ldan dga' ma'i mngal khur rab lci ba'i// sa 'dzin dbang po'i spo mtho 'jig rten gyi// byed pos dbyar skyes rkang 'thung lo 'dab sogs// 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho ched du sprul snyam der// rir skyes tshogs ni ris mthun rtse 'jor rol// 'dab chags sna tshogs 'phur lding mgrin snyan gyi// gling bu 'khrol bas lha dang drang srong yang*// yid dgar byed pa'i ri bo'i rtse mo na// rdo rje brag ri rin chen 'bar ba yi// cod paṇa thod du bcings 'dra'i rtse rgyal gyis// sngo bsangs mkha' dbyings 'bigs na mi rung zhes// chu 'dzin stug po'i gos kyis g.yogs snyam byed// de na rin chen las grub khang bzang ni// srid pa'i dpal 'byor 'dod dgus gtams pa nas// 'bar lha chen po rje blon btsun mo sras// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ

bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ srid pa las 'das skyabs yul yon tan zhing*// thams cad sprin ltar gtibs pa'i 'og rol char// srid pa'i lha chen 'khor bcas rab dga'i 'dzum// dkar po'i khor yug mun pa bkru bzhin 'khod// gsal gdab pa ni/ kye yul bdag lha chen sku dbyibs cha lugs dag /mtha' gcig nges gzung med de rdzu 'phrul dang*// mthu chen rnams kyi lus byad skad cig ma'i// kun rtog rjes su son pa'i grangs ston phyir// 'on te gna' dus grags pa'i rtsig logs su// rig pa'i tshon pir gyis bris 'bar lha che// ston zla stong gi dkar mdzes lang tsho'i dpal// byed pos gcig tu spungs 'dra'i lha yi lus// stong 'khun yul gyi 'phrul bzos btags pa'i dar// rab dkar lhab lhub g.yo ba'i phod ka yis// nyi 'od kyis khyab sprin dkar phung po dag /mkha' dbyings lang ling g.yo ba'i dregs pa 'gog /nor bu dbang gi rgyal po phyag g.yas su// thogs pas ci 'dod dbyig gi char rgyun 'bebs// g.yon pas dge bar spyod dang rgyal bstan la// dga' ba'i dar mdung dkar po mkha' la bsgreng*// zla gzhon 'od kyi lcug phran byed po yis// thags su bskrun lta'i dar dkar la thod bcing*// sna tshogs nor bu'i phra tshom pa tra yi// mngal khur sbrums pa'i gser gyi rna cha g.yo// yul phyogs bde 'byor rgyas par spel ba na// rin chen khri 'phang 'dod yon dgyes dgur rtsen// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i bya rar rgyu ba dang*// nag phyogs dgra sde gzhom la chas pa'i gzugs// dgra bo'i snying 'bigs mda' ldan dong pa dang*// rgyud kyis bkug pa'i gnam rur bcas pa'i shubs// dku yi g.yas g.yon dpyangs pa'i ska rags la// rno ngar 'bar ba'i ral gri shubs ldan gzer// bsams pa'i gnas kun skad cig bskor bzod pa'i// gom stabs stong phrag rnam par g.yo ba'i rta// rin chen gser gyi sga srab spras pa'i steng*// sag ti'i l+h+wam gyis sgeg pa'i zhabs gnyis rol// lha chen de yi g.yas g.yon rang rigs dang*// rjes su mthun pa'i 'bar lha gcen dang gcung*// gnyis ka'i sku mdangs gangs kyi ri bo'i dpal// nyung ngur bgyid la dar dkar phod kas bklubs// mi srun dgra bo gzhom pa'i rtsal rdzogs brdar// lag g.yas reg gcod ral gri klad la 'phyar// rgyal ba mchod cing 'gro la ci 'dod dpal// ster byed g.yon pas gter gyi bum bzang bsnams// 'phong skyen 'khrul 'khor bskor la mkhas pa'i brdar// mda' gzhu ral gri shubs gsum rked par btags// dbu la zhwa dkar zla ba tshes pa'i rtser// cod paṇa zar bu dmar po g.yo bas mdzes// sag ti'i l+h+wam dang ldan pa'i g.yo ldan zhabs// yid mgyogs rjes su gom pa bkod pa'i rta// gangs ri'i dum bu 'gro shes lta bu la// dar stan sga srab mdzes pa chibs su bcibs// lha yi yum lcam klu rigs mtshar sdug gzugs// skye 'gro'i snying gi ri dwags 'ching ba gnyis// lha mi gdengs can yul gyi nor bu dang*// dar zab kyis brgyan gter gyi sgrom bu bsnams// de dag 'khor du a mye mgar chen dang*// bya ze mdzes legs mdo brag g.yu 'phru can// sgang ri dkar zal bong sna'i dar mdung dkar// a byag mda' sgro can dang dbu zam phyug

/ska lha mgo thi lha rtse la sogs pa// khor yug ri klung nags tshal gor ma chur// brten par bcas pa'i sa bdag yul gyi lha// thams cad rab dga' rgyas pa'i 'dzum gyis 'khod// mchod rdzas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod rdzas rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang nyid las// snang stong dbyer med sgyu ma'i longs spyod ltar// mchod yul dbang po lnga yi spyod yul du// 'dod yon mchod sprin nam mkha' mnyam gyur cig /'bar lha 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i nyer spyad du// rin chen khang bzang ka gdung grangs med can// thog phub kha bad sgo dang rta babs dang*// rgya phibs tog gi 'od rnon 'phro ba can// lha mi klu yi dpal 'byor longs spyod dang*// nor bu rin chen gser dngul dar zab gos// ja bzang 'bru rigs g.yag lug ra skyes khyu// rta phyugs theg pa 'dod 'jo bzhon ma'i rigs// ri dwags sna tshogs rigs mthun spang rir rtser// spu sdug bya rigs 'phur lding skad snyan 'byin// mche sder gdug pa'i gcan gzan 'dur mo nyul// ja chang phye mar bza' btung zhim dgu 'bul// dbyar dus dga' mas phun tshogs dus ston du// ris bral skye 'gro mgron du gnyer byas pa'i// rkang 'thung lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs// g.yur du za ba'i lha shing spos kyi rigs// mtshun zar gtul ba'i dud sprin zhing khams kun// khyab par 'thul bas 'dod yon lnga 'gyed cing*// nyes tshogs sbyong la pha rol phyin drug gi /nus pa rdzogs pa'i bsang mchod rgya chen 'dis// 'bar lha gnyen po rje blon lcam mo 'bangs// 'khor bcas bsang mchod 'bul lo dgyes par rol// 'jig rten skyong ba'i 'byung po khyed cag la// 'os pa'i phrin las bcol la gcig tu dgongs// 'khon ston 'jam dbyangs rat+na dh+wa dza sogs// rig pa 'dzin mchog ljongs 'dir gang byon pas// mthun rdzas gtor mas brngan te bka' lung gis// bsgos pa'i 'phrin yig snying la bris don ltar// skyabs gsum rin chen gtsug gi rgyan du chings// gzhan don byang chub 'dod pa'i sems mchog bskyed// chos kun skye 'gag gnas pa bral rtogs na// sdug bsngal kun las grol 'gyur rgyal bas gsungs// khyed cag bsrungs pa'i yul grur rgyal ba dang*// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob lugs bzang dri ma med// bshad sgrub lhur len grangs med ngur smrig 'chang*// dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i stong grogs mdzad// bdag cag rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag mi dang phyugs// gzhir sdod byes su bzhud pa'i gnas skabs dag

/dgra rkun nyer 'tshe nyes phyogs kun bsrungs nas// bde legs khe 'byor rgyas pa'i dpal la sbyor// dga' bde dpal 'byor dar bab bcud 'thung la// phrag dog dgra 'dre gdon bgegs 'khrugs gyur pa'i// kha yi na bun mi nad phyugs nad dang*// bkres rngabs 'thab rtsod mi 'byung bsrung ba gyis// ljongs 'dir btsa' than sad ser mi gtong bar// bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'tsham pas sngun bsu ba'i// lo legs 'bras bu smin pa'i ro bcud can// 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho 'dzad med spel bar mdzod// ring 'tsho tshe yi skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun// bsod nams sa gzhi yangs par 'khyil ba'i nang*// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor chu skyes 'dab stong bzhad// bde skyid bung ba'i dga' glu len par mdzod// skabs gsum ltos 'gro mi yul 'jig rten gyi// chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phywa g.yang rnams// 'di na tshur bsdus bdag dang sbyin bdag gi /mi nor chos 'byor 'phel ba'i bkra shis stsol// zang zing chos kyi sbyin pas mnyes gyur pa'i// yul bdag 'khor dang bcas pas bcol ba'i las// rtag tu bsgrub pa'i g.yar dam bzung ba'i yid// dga' ba'i 'dzum bcas rang gnas bzhud kyang rung*// zhes gser ldan dga' ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag 'bar lha rtse rgyal 'khor dang bcas par bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yul der skye ba'i sdong bu bzung ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// 'bri chu gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag bong sna'i dge bsnyen dar mdung dkar po can 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga dri za'i bu mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ gang bsams dngos po 'phral 'jo ba// yul lha brngan pa'i mthu las byung*// de yang bsang mchod dam pas te// bsang tshul cho ga bral las min// gang phyir dge bsnyen mthu chen thob// 'khor bcas bsang gi mgron gnyer ba// cho ga'i sprin chen 'khun pa'i dbyangs// don gnyer mdongs mtha'i dpal du 'jebs// 'dir yul lha gnyen po bong sna'i dar mdung dkar po can 'khor dang bcas pa la bsang mchod 'bul ba dag gis/

gtor ma dang bsang rdzas mchod rdzas ji ltar 'byor pa bshams la 'di skad do// oṃ bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// bdag cag byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa'i mthus// mchod 'os yid kyi shing rta 'gengs bzod pa'i// mi zad mchod sprin mkha' dang mnyam gyur cig /hrīḥbadag nyid phyag na pad+mas mtshan pa'i lha// sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras pa yid 'ong sku// rab dkar gangs kyi lhun por brgya byin tshon// na tshod gsar pas bklubs 'dra shin tu gsal// thugs ka'i sa bon 'od kyi pho nya yis// bong sna zhes bya 'dod 'byung ri'i dbang po// margad phung po spungs pa byer dogs nas// rdo rje'i brag ri brtsegs pas brling byas snyam// de na nor bu'i khang brtsegs blta na sdug /brgya byin pho brang nyid dang dbyer med pa// de sogs gnas nas dar mdung dkar po can// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ// kye thub bstan nyi ma rgyas pa'i 'od rtse yis// legs phye shis pa'i ge sar dgod pa can// bod chen pad+ma dkar po'i 'dab phreng gi /bye brag 'bri chu gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram// gya nom dpal gyis yongs gtams bong sna'i rir// nye bar rten bcas dkar po dge ba'i phyogs// skyong la dga' ba'i 'dzum zer grol ba'i lha// dar mdung dkar po zhes bya'i dge bsnyen che// dpal 'dzum zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa las// dbu rgyan snyan cha g.yo ba'i 'od ris can// mu tig 'od rlabs 'bar ba 'o ma'i mtshor// gser gyi pad+mas mtshon bzhin dkar la mdzes// rab dmar dar gyi la thod dbu la bcings// sku la 'jam mnyen chu skyes 'dab ma yis// rjes 'gro ri dwags pags pa'i gos bzang dang*// rin chen rus pa'i rgyan phran du mas bklubs// zla gzhon 'od kyi lcug phran gzhon nu dag /byed pos thags su bskrun lta'i rab dkar gyi// phod ka'i lding gos lhab lhub g.yo ba yis// sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha lugs ci yang rdzogs// phyag g.yas sba lcag dkar po mkha' la 'phyar// g.yon pas ci 'dod dngos grub char gyi rgyun// rtag 'jo nor bu'i rgyal po dang mnyam du// dar dkar rnam par g.yo ba'i mdung rnon bsgreng*// zhabs gnyis an+da rnyil gyi rwa ldan g.yag

/kai la sha yi spun zla bsam pa'i gnas// skad cig bskor ba'i rmig bzhi'i gom rlabs can// sga stan rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan par bcibs// res 'ga' shugs drag rlung gi 'tshub ma la// 'gran zlar 'os pa rmig pa'i 'degs 'jog gi /'dzam bu'i gling kun bgrod la mi ngal ba'i// dung gi ra rgyas rir skyes sha ba'i steng*// cha lugs snga ma nyid las mi 'gyur yang*// g.yas pa'i phyag gis gang la dmigs pa'i gnad// 'bigs byed rgod po'i sgro ldan mda' lnga dang*// g.yon pa'i phyag gis gzhur bcas dar mdung bsnams// res 'ga' shin tu dul brling rab dkar rta// rnga rngog zar bu bskyod pa'i 'gros legs kyis// yid kyi ri dwags 'ching ba'i zhags pa zhig /gser gyi sga dang srab mchog spras pa'i steng*// byed po tshangs chen yid kyis bris pa lta'i// gzugs mchog skye mched legs pa'i lha lus la// kā shi ka yi ras mchog dri med las// grub pa'i gos kyis slar yang mdzes par byas// le brgan dar gyi thod dang gser byang gi /cod paṇa 'od du 'bar ba dbur bcings nas// sba lcag nor bu dang bcas dar gyi mdung*// dkar po'i phyogs su slong ba ci ste lhod// gang bsams 'phog pa'i mdas bkang dong pa dang*// rgyud kyis bkug pa'i sgra ldan gzhur bcas shubs// g.yas g.yon rked par dpyangs pa'i ska rags su// reg pa gcod pa'i ral gri rnon po gzir// rdzu 'phrul mthu chen rnams kyis sprul pa'i lus// skad cig sems kyi 'gyur ba'i grangs ston phyir// spros pa'i cha lugs mtha' dag brjod dka' yang*// ngo mtshar gtam gyi gling bu de tsam bsgyur// 'khor du dkar po dge ba'i phyogs skyong la// dga' ba'i ru mtshon dkar po mkhar bsgreng ba'i// 'brog chen g.yag ze a byag mda' sgro phyug /lo chen nags mdzangs khro bo rgyal mtshan can// gya nom mtsho sman 'bo brag phyug mdzangs dang*// dung brag seng smug chos sku yum gcig ma// sgrog gi rab dkar sgrog brag nor bu bzang*// gser phye mched brgyad dar ma mched brgyad sogs// gzhan yang yul 'di'i nyen skor khor yug gi

/ri klung nags tshal slas dang lam gyi srong*// rdo chu gnyen po rnams su rten bcas pa'i// sa bdag yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad gsal// bsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ khyed cag dgyes pa'i gtor ma ri ltar spungs// mkha' lding dbyar gyi rnga gsang gdong lnga pa// g.yag lug ra skyes ri dwags 'dab ldan rigs// go cha mtshon cha rin chen 'bru sman dar// phye mar ja sogs bza' btung gya nom dang*// char ldan dus kyi bu mos lo ma dang*// me tog 'bras bu dar bab bskyed pa'i shing*// bzang dgu gtul ba'i dud sprin sngo bsangs mas// bsang ngo mchod do dar mdung dkar po'i lha// 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang po lnga'i mdzod ni// 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa ci dang cis// yongs gtams dga' ba'i 'dzum brgya grol gyur cig /'phags pa phyag na pad+mas byang chub tu// thugs bskyed brling ba'i phrag par dam bca'i khur// zhing sbyong sems can smin pa'i spyod mchog gis// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char pas yang yang bkrus// bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje nas bzung ste// da lta'i bar byon thub pa'i gdung 'tshob kyis// chos gtam bdud rtsi'i thigs pas snying la brlan// bsgos pa'i yi ge dam pa dran par gyis// mi bslu nges pa'i skyabs gsum gtsug tu mchod// gzhan don byang chub sems kyi dam pa skyed// chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa'i tshul shes shing*// 'jig rten khams su dge legs 'byung bar mdzod// thun mtshams dmar mdangs bag yod khrims kyis dben// bshad sgrub bgyi bas bstan la sman pa bral// yon tan de dag gis mdzes ngur smrig 'chang*// grangs med 'dus pas sa steng brgyan par mdzod// bdag cag yon sbyor byed po 'khor bcas kyi// nyes pa'i phyogs srung legs pa'i tshogs spel phyir// nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe dang*// gzhis kyi srung ma byes kyi dgra lha mdzod// bde 'byor rgyas pa bdud rtsi'i ro 'thung la// gegs byed mi nad phyugs nad ma btang cig

/lo thog 'bras bu'i lang tsho 'phrog pa'i nad// btsa' then sad dang rdo char yang ma btang*// tshe dbang 'byor pa'i chu gter 'khyil pa'i klong*// rtse 'jor rol pa'i sems kyi ngang pa mo// rab dga' rgyas pa'i 'phur lding stong bsgyur zhing*// shis brjod mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol bar mdzod// mthu ldan khyed rnams mel tshe yod pa'i khongs// bdag sogs sdang ba byed pa'i dgra byung tshe// skad cig gnyis par gson du ster byed na// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung gi dgos pa ci// stong gsum lha dbang klu dbang mi bdag gi /tshe dang bsod nams rigs brgyud dpal 'byor rnams// sbrang rtsi 'dzin pas pad+ma'i bcud bzhin du// shis pa'i gnas 'dir khugs la g.yang du stsol// ces brjod la gtor ma rnams yul lha'i phyogs su btang la/ lhang lhang snyan pa'i bsang mchod dri za'i glus// spros spros mchod pa'i mgron du gnyer ba rnams// 'dzum 'dzum so yi ge sar dgod pa bzhin// rang rang gnas su bde bar dengs shig muḥ// zhes brjod do// de ltar 'bri chu gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag bong sna'i dge bsnyen dar mdung dkar po can 'khor dang bcas pas bsang mchod kyi cho ga dri za'i bu mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lha 'dir bsang mchod byas na yul phyogs dge ba'i mngon mtshan 'ga' zhig shar bar sngar nas brtsam pa'i 'dun pa yod pa'i khar/ mdzangs shing zab pa'i blo ldan khyim bdag lha dbang mgon pos bskul ba'i rkyen byas te/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa brgyud par bcas pa'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag dge bsnyen mched lcam 'khor dang bcas pa la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga shis pa g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs//

༄༅// yon tan rmad byung bla ma lhar// yid kyi pad+ma mngon phyogs nas// snod bcud dge ba'i rtsa lag tu// yul lha dgyes pa'i bsang mchod 'dri// 'dir 'bri klung gser ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag dge bsnyen mched lcam 'khor dang bcas pa la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas gtor ma zlum gtor gcig la khyung 'brug seng ge gsum dang*/ g.yag lug ra skyes rnams kyis brgyan pa dang*// bsang rdzas phun sum tshogs pa bsags par chab kyis bran te/ gong du bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel ba'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ma song na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs tshar gsum brjod// de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bde gshegs sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin stobs dang*// bdag cag byang chub sems bskyed stobs dag gis// ji ltar bshams dang yid byung mchod pa'i tshogs// mgron rnams dgyes pa'i longs spyod chen por gyur// hrīḥphun tshogs 'bras ldan dus kyi bsil sbyin mkhan// bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar spro la zhugs pa bzhin// bdag nyid 'phags pa thugs rje che ldan sku// zhi 'dzum rgyan gyis brgyan pa lham mer gsal// de yi sa bon 'od kyi dpyangs thag la// mdza' gcugs grogs ltar dga' bas legs 'khyud de// dge bsnyen chen po 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas// bsang mchod gnas 'dir ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ// kye 'phags pa phyag na pad+mas byang chub kyi// spyod pa rgya mtshos byin brlabs bod chen po'i// bye brag 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram// shis pa'i mtshan ris rnam bkra 'dzin ma'i khyon// yangs par mnga' mdzad gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha// 'chi med dge bsnyen khro bo rgyal mtshan gang*// nyi 'od kyis 'khyud gangs kyi ri bo ltar// dkar gsal 'od du 'tsher ba zhi 'dzum zhal// kā shi ras kyi la thod dbu la bcings// g.yas pa'i phyag gis sba lcag tshigs gsum gsor// chu skyes rtsa ba'i snal ma gzhon nu dag /byed pos thags su btags 'dra'i phod kas mdzes// bdud kyi dge bsnyen rdo rje bdud 'dul ni// sku mdog in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs 'od 'tsher// bzhin gyi smin 'khyog gdong mig g.yon du bsgyur// le brgan dar gyi 'khyud mos skra tshogs bsdam// lag g.yas reg pa gcod pa'i ral gri sngo// rdo rje'i yu ba byas pa klad la bskor// gser gyi thig les rab bkra dar nag gos// mdzes pas rgyu skar ldan ma'i dpal la 'phyo// btsan gyi dge bsnyen rdo rje drag po rtsal// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor chags pa'i nyams su bzhad// brjid ldan sku yi byi ru'i lhun po la// zhwa dang gos dmar thun mtshams sprin gyis bklubs// btsan gyi zhags dmar glog gi lus 'gyu ma// g.yas pa'i phyag gis dgra la 'phen zhing 'debs// de dag gsum ga'ang lag g.yon rang rang gi

/kha dog mthun pa'i dar mdung mkha' la bsgreng*// rin chen phra tshom bkod pa'i ska rags la// gang bsams 'bigs pa'i mdas bkang dong pa g.yas// sra ba'i gzhu bdungs shubs ma g.yon du 'phyang*// sag ti'i l+h+wam gyis mdzes pa g.yo ldan zhabs// myur mgyogs dri yi bzhon pa'i grags pa yang*// dal bu nyid du bgyid pa'i cang shes rta// rang rang sku mdog mthun pa'i spu sdug la// rin chen sga srab mdzes pa'i steng na rol// g.yas na sprul pa'i seng ge dkar mo bsgyings// g.yon na stag mo grus ma'i mchongs stabs sgyur// mi dkar lha g.yag mang po snga phyir rgyug /gtum chen khra dang bya rgod bla na 'phyo// dge bsnyen chen po'i lcam mo mtshar sdug gsum// mngon shes me long thogs pa'i zla bzhin ma// sha ba'i yu mo la chibs stong gsum nyul// kha sha'i bzhon par rtsen pa'i gser bzhin ma// sba dkar gling du snyan pa'i dbyangs su 'jo// rma bya'i sgro thul gyon pa'i sngo bsangs bzhin// rwa ldan btsod kyi steng na gling bu bsgyur// kun kyang dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// de dag rigs su mthun pa'i 'khor dang g.yog /lha dang bdud btsan klu sman grangs med dang*// nag po 'phred nyal ya ma rkya gcig dang*// 'brog rje gsum sogs mchod par 'os pa'i mgron// ming nas smos kyis ma ldongs thams cad la// phang phung lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu yi// khur bus dud pa'i lha shing sna tshogs dang*// bzang drug sman sbyar bsregs pa dud pa'i sprin// sngo bsangs nam mkha'i khams kun bgrod pa mkhan// ja chang phye mar la sogs ro drug gi /bcud du che ba'i bza' btung gtor ma dang*// 'dab ldan rgyal po 'brug dang ri dwags dgra// g.yung nor ri dwags spyan gzigs dpag med rnams// dge bsnyen mched lcam 'khor dang bcas pa la// 'bul lo bsang ngo yid kyi bang mdzod dag /ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos po de dang des// gtams nas dgyes pa rab rtser 'dzegs gyur cig

/thugs rje che dang pad+mā ka ra nas// da lta'i bar byon rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis// gdams pa'i bdud rtsi bsten nas bka' lung gi /ri mo snying la bkod de dran par gyis// bla med dkon mchog gsum po skyabs su zung*// gzhan don byang chub 'dod pa'i sems mchog skyed// chos rnams rang bzhin spros dang bral shes nas// bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i phrin las sgrubs// khyad par bdag cag yon sbyor mi phyugs bcas// gzhi byes kun du skyed byed dam ma yis// gces pa'i bu ltar nyes pa las bsrung zhing*// legs pa sgrub pa'i stong grogs dpung gnyen mdzod// lus kyi stobs dang 'tsho ba 'phrog pa'i dug /mi phyugs nad kyi kha rlangs ma btang zhig /lo thog 'bras bu smin la sdang ba'i dgra// rdo char sad dang btsa' then ma btang zhig /ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe dang bsod nams stobs// bde dga' 'byor pa rgyas pa mis sbyin bu'i// dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa mi'i 'jig rten// 'di na yongs su 'phos snyam nyid du mdzod// dbang po kun nas tshim byed lha bsang gi /mgron du dmigs pa'i rkyen gyis bos pa rnams// dga' ba rab kyi shing rta la chibs te// rang rang 'dod pa'i gnas su bde bar dengs// zhes bris klung gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag dge bsnyen mched lcam 'khor dang bcas pa la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga shis pa g.yas su 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khyim bdag bsod nams nyi mas bskul ngor// thub pa'i rgyal tshab e waṃ pa chen po brgyud par bcas pa'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// ldan yul ska phu'i gzhi bdag gi bsang mchod cho ga sbrang rtsi'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// snang byed 'od khyab kha ba'i rdul brtsegs bzhin// blta na ngoms med rab dkar spyan ras gzigs// gang dang gnyis min bla mar phyag bgyis nas// yul lha'i bsang mchod sbrang rtsi'i mgrin glu len// 'dir ska phu'i gzhi bdag la bsang mchod bya bas/

gzhi bdag gtor ma/ mda' dar/ phye mar/ spos shing sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang ba rnams spyi ltar byas la/ bsang gzhan gyi gzhi bdag gi skabs sogs gang yang rung bar/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i ngag tu/ kye rin chen brag chen brtsegs pa ri yi dbang*// chu ska lhung lhung sgra snyan 'bab pa'i phu// lha gnas sa la 'phos lta'i khang bzang nas// ska lha phyug mo 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyon// spang ri g.yu yi mdog ltar sngo ba la// shel brag nor bu spungs 'dra mgar thog gi /pho brang la gnas a mye lha chen po// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ/ bzhugs su bcug pa ni/ kye 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma dal 'bab 'gram// nor 'dzin dum bu skyong ba'i bdag mo ru// srid pas bskos shing dkar phyogs skyong ba la// 'dzum dkar rgyas pa'i ska lha phyug mo ni// zla gzhon bye ba'i mtshar sdug lang tsho'i dpal// byed pos gcig tu spungs ltar yid 'phrog gzugs// mthon mthing len bu rin chen phreng bas spa// sku la dar gos rin chen do shal bklubs// lag g.yas mda' dar srid pa'i phywa g.yang 'gugs// g.yon pas ci 'dod gter gyi nor gzhong bsnams// bde 'jam stan la sgeg chags tshul gyis gnas// res 'ga' ri dwags bu mo la zhon te// bsam pa'i gnas kun skad cig gcig la bskor// rang mthun smin legs lus phra'i 'khor gyis bskor// mthu rtsal rmad byung a mye lha chen ni// bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor dkar smug khro zhing 'jum// phyag g.yas nag phyogs 'joms pa'i mdung rnon bsgreng*// g.yon pas 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs nor bu 'dzin// kā shi'i ras dkar lding gos sku la gsol// zar bu dmar mdzes zhwa dkar dbu la brgyan// sag ti'i l+h+wam ldan zhabs su sngo bsangs rta// rgyan ldan gom stabs stong la mkhas pa bcibs// res 'ga' zhwa nag rdo rje'i tog mtshan la// tshon lnga'i dar dpyangs me long 'od stong 'tsher// mthing ga'i 'jol ber gsol ba'i ska rags la// gnam lcags phur bu gzer sogs zhi drag gi

/cha lugs cir yang ston pa'i yul lha rje// 'khor bcas dga' ba'i sems kyis 'khod par gyur// bsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ oṃ gang la skyabs song mi bslu gtam gyi rnga// bden mthas legs par brdung ba dkon mchog gi /byin gyis brlabs kyis sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin// 'dod yon 'dzad pa med pa'i gter gyur cig /'dod pa'i yon tan nor bu gser dngul ja// go cha mtshon cha dar gos g.yag lug ra// 'dab ldan ri dwags theg pa bzhon ma'i rigs// ja chang gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum phye// lha shing sna tshogs spos sbyar bsregs pa'i sprin// mi gtsang sbyang zhing ci 'dod 'byung gnas 'dis// ska lha phyug mo a mye lha chen po// 'khor bcas bsang ngo mchod do dges par rol// ljongs 'dir grub pa'i gdung 'tshob rim byon gyis// bsgos pa'i bka' don ma bskyungs snying la chongs// dkon mchog skyabs gzung byang chub sems mchog skyed// chos dang chos mdzad gus pa'i ri mor byos// bdag cag sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi// tshe dang dbang thang dpal 'byor rigs kyi rgyud// rdo rje dpag bsam shing dang chu yi gter// skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun gyi rjes 'gror mdzod// gang dag phyogs su dgos pa gang gi phyir// 'gro ba'i skyel ma 'ong ba'i bsu ba dang*// dgra bgegs mi mthun nyes pa'i phyogs las srungs// legs pa'i dpal brgyar sbyor ba'i stong grogs mdzod// rnam smin lus kyi stobs dang bde ba srog /za byed gshin rje'i kha yi rlangs 'dra ba// mi nad phyugs nad mu ge 'thab rtsod rnams// yul 'dir mi 'byung srung ba'i mel tshe mdzod// 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho dbyar las skyes pa'i dpal// nyams byed btsa' sad ser bas mi 'tshe bar// bsrungs pa'i khongs su rtsi shing lo thog rgyas// ro bcud phun tshogs 'bras bu'i dga' ston stsol// rtag tu bde dga' rgyas pa'i g.yang rnams ni// 'di na len to sangs rgyas bdud sde las// rnam par rgyal ba'i shis pa dag kyang ngo*// zhes brjod cing gtor ma yul lha'i phyogs su btang la bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// zhes ldan yul ska phu'i gzhi bdag gi bsang mchod cho ga sbrang rtsi'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba 'di ni/

ska mdo'i phrin las kyis bskul ngor/ snyan dngags pa tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// 'bri chu gser ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag brag dkar dung 'dra'i lha mo mched gsum la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga rin chen rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// legs byas rgya mtsho'i snying po mtshungs pa'i bzhin// dkar gsal 'dzums su dmul bas mdun bsu zhing*// 'gro la ye shes dag pa'i spyan ras kyis// gzigs pa'i dbang phyug bla ma la btud de// dbyig ldan brtan ma'i lto bar chos srid kyi// dge legs dpal 'byor spel ba'i mdza' na mo// brag dkar dung 'dra'i legs bris dpal mo mched// dgyes bskyed bsang mchod rin chen rgyud mangs 'khrol// de la bsang rdzas mchod gtor ci 'byor pa bshams la/ 'di skad gyer ro// oṃ mchod rdzas rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings nyid las// mchod yul dbang po lnga yi longs spyod du// mchod gtor gya nom 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// mchod 'os dgyes par rol pa'i chu gter gyur// spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lha gsal thugs ka nas// 'od rtse la chags 'dod pa'i rgyal po spros// brag dkar legs bris bu mo mched gsum ni// thogs med gnas 'dir ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ kun gsal lus phra'i 'gram par dbang gzhu'i gar// dbang rgyas phrin las sgrub pa'i rnam 'phrul gzugs// cir yang ston pa'i brag dkar lha mo gsum// rin chen rgyan phreng khrol ler brtan par bzhugs// mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ kye phun tshogs gser ldan dga' ma'i thig le'i dpyid// mar gad phung po spungs snyam ri bo'i ngos// brag dkar dung dang zla shel brtsegs lta'i nang*// lta na sdug pa'i rin chen khang bzang dbus// ljongs 'dir chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor sde// spel ba'i rtsa lag srid pas rnam bskos pa// brag dkar dung 'dra'i gnas kyi bdag mo gsum// lha mi gdengs can longs spyod gter gyi bdag

/'jo sgeg lang tsho dar bab zur mig gis// srid gsum snying gi brtan pa cig car du// 'phrog pa'i mtshar la rin chen rgyan tshogs rnams// phan tshun lag sbrel gad mo dgod snyam byed// khyed rnams dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas yid 'phrog gzugs// sgra snyan sna tshogs dri zhim rol pa'i rdzing*// ro bcud phun tshogs bza' bca'i ri bo spungs// gos bzang rnam bkra brgya byin tshon gyi zla// cod paṇa rna cha nyi zla'i 'od la 'phya// ci 'dod gter bum la sogs 'bru yi rigs// ja chang 'o ma'i btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil// g.yag lug ra skyes ri dwags rtse 'jor rol// dri zhim bsang mchod rdzogs ldan sprin gyi spun// nyes skyon sbyangs pas khyab 'jug zhabs bsil mod// 'dod dgu 'jo bas dpag bsam rkang 'thung gi /rjes su snyegs pa'i bsang mchod dam pa 'bul// ljongs 'dir bstan pa'i chu gter rgyas pa'i klong*// bshad sgrub mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol mkhas pa'i// dge 'dun ngang pa'i phreng bas yongs gang zhing*// phan bde'i klung brgya 'bebs pa'i stong grogs mdzod// bdag cag yon sbyor byed pa 'khor dang bcas// gzhi byes kun du nyes pa'i phyogs las srungs// bde legs phyogs kyi sgo brgya phye ba las// gang bsam skad cig 'grub pa'i las mdzod cig /phywa g.yang dgug cing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ srid pa gsum gyi bde dga' 'byor ba'i tshogs// tshur bsdus 'di na phywa g.yang dngos grub stsol// ji ltar bsgos pa'i 'phrin yig snying ga la// bkod pa rjes su sgrub pa'i 'dzum gyis bzhud// bsngo ba smon lam ni/ chos ldan 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor srung ba'i lha// dgyes bskyed bsang mchod bgyis pa'i dge ba yis// gtong ba rnam bzhi'i pha rol phyin gyur nas// 'jig rten rgyud pa gzhil ba'i mchog gyur cig /ces 'bri chu gser ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag brag dkar dung 'dra'i lha mo mched gsum la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga rin chen rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di ni gtsug lag zung gi mkhyen dpyod rnam gsal sa skyong blo bzang byams pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/

ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas na tshod ldan gyi gnam lo'i nag zla'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis par sbyar ba sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// 'bri klung gser ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag sing lha ngom gsal 'khor bcas la bsang mchod stob pa'i cho ga bkra shis dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ na ma ar+yā lo ke shwa rā ya/ kun mkhyen bzhi pa'i legs gsungs 'od brgya pas// skal ba dman pa'i mun bcom bod chen ljongs// dbyig 'dzin dga' ma'i dum bu ne'u sing gis// rnam mdzes yul gyi bdag po'i bsang mchod 'dri// 'dir sing lha 'khor bcas la bsang mchod bya bas/ gzhi bdag gi dkar gtor spyi ltar dang*/ phye mar ja chang*/ shing rtsi sna tshogs dang spos kyi dud pa btang la/ spyi bsang rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang rung sngon du btang nas/ 'di skad gyer ro// hrīḥbadag nyid lhag pa'i lha mchog spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje'i zla ba rgyas pa'i zil dngar gyis// gangs can phan bde'i sa mo'i tshal gyi kha// brgya phrag bzhad pa'i rtsa lag mchog gi sku// snang stong sgyu ma ltar gsal thugs ka nas// 'od zer lcags kyu bye ba'i 'phro 'du yis// spang ri mar gad gsar pa'i 'og pag can// gzhom bral nor bu'i brag ri brtsegs pa'i nang*// skabs gsum grong gi rjes 'gro'i bsti gnas sogs// gar bzhugs gnas nas sing lha ngom gsal can// btsun mo rigs sras 'khor du gtogs par bcas// thogs med 'dir spyon ā kār+ṣa ya dzaḥ// zhes pas spyan drangs/ yo byad spel ba ni/ oṃ phyag na pad+ma'i thugs bskyed smon lam dang*// bdag cag lhag pa'i sems bskyed stobs dag gis// bshams dang sprul pa'i mchod sprin gya nom pas// kun gsal lus phra'i 'gram dkyus gtams gyur cig /mgron gsal gdab cing mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ kye 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma dal 'bab ma'i// 'gram ngogs ne'u sing ldan pa'i ljongs kyi lha// ngom gsal zhes bya sgeg 'dzum zla ba'i bzhin// rin chen rna cha nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'tsher// phyag g.yas kun las rnam rgyal ba dan bsgreng*// g.yon pas ci 'dod 'jo ba'i yid bzhin nor// zla zhun thags su btags snyam gos dkar dang*// dar dmar cod paṇa g.yo ba'i zhwa dkar mdzes// gcod 'bigs thogs pa med pa'i ral gri dang*// nyag phran gnam ru shubs ldan rked par bskor// rdzu 'phrul gom stabs mkhas pa'i cang shes rta// sngon po sga srab spras pa'i steng na brjid// brag 'dzi dga' ma mtshar sdug sgeg mo'i gzugs// sna tshogs gos dang nor bu'i rgyan phreng bklubs// tshe dang longs spyod gter gyi bum pa dag

/lag pa'i chu skyes kyis bzung stan la rol// lha chen sras po rdo rje dpal 'bar dang*// nye brag gser can shong ngu stag rtse can// mtsho ra dmag dpon gser lding ri bkra dang*// brag btsan rgyal po rong chen rnga 'dra ste// kun kyang gang bsams gnas su skad cig gcig /bgrod byed rlung la 'khu ba'i rta mchog chibs// lag g.yas res 'ga' sba lcag dkar po gdengs// cig shos dkar phyogs dgyes pa'i ru mtshon bslang*// res 'ga' zhi byed bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// lan rer ci 'dod gter gyi bum pa bzang*// res 'ga' sna tshogs 'bru yi sgrom bu dang*// lan rer ral gri mdung rnon mda' gzhu thogs// kha dog cha lugs zhi 'dzum sgeg chags dang*// mi sdug rnam pa las kyi kun rtog gi /rjes mthun 'phrul las mtha' gcig nges min pa// mthu chen 'byung po kun gyi khyad chos yin// gzhan yang shong du mtsho sman rgyal mo dang*// mon thog g.yung drung bon po mched brgyad dang*// ri nyin bon po ri ldeb 'tsho byed rje// brag khud a mye mthu chen ral pas phyug /dge phu brag dkar gnas po dmar lcog can// gdong 'dzom yid 'phrog lus phra spun gsum dang*// ri dil gsum gnas gzhi yi bdag po ste// de kun rigs mthun 'khor dang yang 'khor bcas// gzhan yang nyen skor ri khyim gang dag tu// gnas pa'i lha btsan 'byung por bcas pa la// dgyes bskyed bsang mchod dam pa 'bul ba ni// ro mchog brgya ldan gtor ma ri ltar spungs// g.yag lug ra skyes ri dwags khyu nang rtse// gnyis skyes spu sdug sna tshogs rgyang glu len// ci 'dod gter gyi bum pa dpag bsam shing*// sa le sbram dang lcags mchog rin po che// a rdo da ka dar zab 'bru yi rigs// dkar mngar phye mar phung po tshar du dngar// ja bzang bdud rtsi'i skyems kyi chu gter 'khyil// dri zhim spos dang lha shing gzhon nu dag

/gtul ba'i dud pa ston ka'i sprin dkar la// 'gran pa'i zlar chas nyes grib kun sbyangs shing*// mngon 'dod yon tan ci yang 'byung ba 'dis// sing lha gnyen po 'khor sde ris su bcas// bsang ngo mchod do dgyes shing tshim gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum po gtan gyi skyabs gzung zhing*// 'gro la phan pa'i byang chub sems mchog bskyed// chos kun spros dang bral bar shes bgyis na// sdug bsngal kun las grol 'gyur rgyal bas gsungs// ljongs kun brtse ba che dang e waṃ pa'i// lugs mchog dpyid kyi lang tsho la chags pa'i// dge 'dun sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan grangs med kyis// bshad sgrub rkang drug dbyangs snyan 'byin mdzod cig /bdag cag yon sbyor 'khor du bcas pa yi// gzhi srung byes kyi lam lha dgra lha gyis// nyes 'pham 'jigs pa kun las bsrung ba dang*// gang bsam legs brgya 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod// dkar phyogs la dgyes sprin sngon phreng ba dkrigs// bdud rtsi'i char rgyun dus las yol med 'bebs// 'bru bcud phun tshogs snye ma g.yur za ba'i// lo legs dga' ston phyogs bral 'gro la stsol// sbyin pa 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba yis// gtong ba rmad byung pha rol phyin gyur nas// lus med thul mchog gdod mas ma bsgral ba'i// 'gro tshogs srid las gdon pa bdag gyur cig /ces 'bri klung gser ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag sing lha ngom gsal 'khor bcas la bsang mchod stob pa'i cho ga bkra shis dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong kun dga' chos 'phel gyis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i na tshod ldan gyi lo'i sa ga zla bar chos sde bsam 'grub pho brang du sug bris su byas pa bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// chu klung gser ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag a mye smug mdzangs can gyi bsang mchod cho ga yul bdag dgyes pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// gang gi thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa'i mtha'// kun gsal dgu tshigs ring mos 'ching min pa'i// bla ma spyan ras gzigs la gus btud de// yul lha dgyes pa'i mchod sprin rgya cher spro// 'dir gzhi bdag a mye smug mdzangs la bsang mchod bya bas/ bsang rdzas mchod gtor ci 'byor pa bshams/ shing rtsi'i dri zhim nam mkhar khyab par gtul la 'di skad gyer ro// hrīḥ bdag nyid gru 'dzin ri bo'i zhing gi bdag /snang stong zung du 'jug pa sgyu ma'i gar// rnam gsal mdun du a mye smug mdzangs can// 'khor bcas mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// margad phung por spung 'dra'i spang sngon ri// gzhom bral rdo rje brag ri brtsegs pa'i nang*// brgya byin pho brang lta bu'i bsti gnas nas// thogs med tshur spyon 'di na brtan par bzhugs// kye srid pa'i phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i rdzu 'phrul mthu// rmad byung a mye smug mdzangs zhes bya ba// zhi zhing sgeg pa'i bzhin ras dkar la dmar// zla ba rgyas pa lta bu'i zhwa dkar la// dzī ba ka 'dra'i cod paṇa g.yo ba dang*// spu sdug ri mo rnam bkra'i stag slog gyon// dus gsum legs nyes ma nor ston byed pa'i// mngon shes 'phrul gyi ju thig mgul par mdzes// yid bzhin nor bu bdud rtsi'i bum pa dag /tshe dang dbyig gi char rgyun 'bebs phyir bzung*// 'dod pa'i gnas kun 'grod byed gro sngon rta// rin chen sga srab brgyan pa zhabs su bcibs// 'khor du nang blon btsun mo pho nya bran// lha btsan klu sman mang pos kun nas bskor// lha khyod 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas su// rin chen gser dngul gter gyi bum pa bzang*// spyan gzigs mchod pa'i gzugs brgya tshar du dngar// bstod dbyangs snyan dngags rol mo 'brug tu ldir// dri 'dzin tshim byed lha bsang dud sprin dkrigs// phye mar dkar dmar bza' bca'i ri bo spungs// ja chang 'o ma'i btung ba rgya mtshor bskyil// sna tshogs dar gos dbang po'i gzhu ris bkra// g.yag lug ra dang ri dwags spang rir rtse// 'dab chags grangs med ngag gi gling bu bsgyur// lo legs 'bru rigs gya nom mdun bdar bas// lha chen a mye smug mdzangs 'khor dang bcas// bsang ngo mchod do dgyes par rol gyur cig

/sngon dus grub dbang pad+mā ka ra sogs// rigs 'dzin rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob grangs med kyis// rgya chen mchod sbyin gtor mas legs bstabs nas// ji ltar bsgos pa'i bka' lung rjes dgongs la// dkon mchog rnam gsum gtan gyi skyabs su zung*// gzhan don sangs rgyas thob pa'i sems mchog bskyed// chos kun don dam spros pa bral shes na// sdug bsngal kun las grol 'gyur rgyal bas gsungs// rdzu 'phrul mthu chen grub pa'i lha khyod kyis// ljongs 'dir mi nad phyugs nad bkres rngabs dang*// dgra rkun sad ser gnod pa mi 'byung bar// gzhi byes kun tu srung skyob ma g.yel cig /ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe dang bsod nams dang*// bde dga' dpal 'byor longs spyod dbang thang rnams// kun nas rgyas pa skabs gsum dbang po yi// phun tshogs bde 'byor lta bur 'phel bar mdzod// ji ltar bsgos pa'i 'phrin yig snying ga la// rnam gsal rjes su dran pas dgyes bzhin bzhud// ris bral 'gro ba'i gnyis skyes gzhon nu rnams// bde legs rgya mtshor spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces chu klung gser ldan ma'i 'gram gyi gzhi bdag a mye smug mdzangs can gyi bsang mchod cho ga yul bdag dgyes pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong kun dga' chos 'phel gyis bskul ba'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis rab byung 'dod pa'i na tshod ldan gyi lor chos sde bsam 'grub pho brang du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// rab bkram brag dkar stag rtse mched 'khor bcas pa'i bsang mchod sprin gyi bzhad sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgyal ba kun 'dus bdag nyid bla ma dang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang tha dad med pa la// gus pas phyag 'tshal srid pa'i bde 'byor sgo// yul lha'i bsang mchod sprin gyi bzhad sgra 'byin// 'dir rab bkram brag dkar stag rtse mched 'khor bcas pa'i bsang mchod bya bar 'dod pas/

snod gtsang mar zlum gtor rtse rgyal mtheb skyu yu mo'i rna ba 'dra ba bzhis brgyan pa'i mtha' skor du/ bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*/ khyung 'brug seng ge g.yag lug ra sogs gzugs 'gros mang po dang zan ril bdun gyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang mda' dar phye mar/ shing rtsi sna tshogs kyi dud pa gtul ba sogs spyi ltar bsham mo// de nas bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel na mi dgos kyang*/ 'di nyid rkyang pa 'don na/ thog mar sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal bas/ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba'i gsang gsum yi ge'i byin rlabs dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyi lhag bsam smon lam mthus// rgyal khams skyong ba'i lha chen mchod pa'i rdzas// rgyal chen ris bzhi'i dpal ltar rgyas gyur cig /mgron spyan drang ba ni/ kye byed pos margad phung po spungs pa la// shel dkar dbang sngon phra tshom bkod 'dra yi// rab bkram brag dkar ri bo'i bsti gnas nas// gser ldan chu bo'i 'gram gyi nor 'dzin ma// stobs kyis mnga' sgyur brag dkar stag rtse mched// rnam gsum rang rang dga' ma bran 'khor bcas// 'di na tshur shog ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ// gsal gdab cing 'khod du gzhug pa ni/ kye gangs can lha gcig phyag na pad+ma yis// byang chub spyod pa rgya mtshos byin gyis brlabs// bla ma mtsho skyes nam mkha' legs pa sogs// rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rim byon gyis// ljongs 'dir dam chos sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad cing*// snod bcud dpal 'byor rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i mgron// 'gugs byed 'jig rten srung bar mnga' gsol ba'i// brag dkar stag rtse mched gsum zhes bya ba// brag dkar byang dmar nag mdzangs stag rtse gsum// rnam pa shel dang sna tshogs tshon gyi mdangs// phrad pa ji bzhin sgyu 'phrul ma nges ston// 'on kyang blo yi me long mthun snang gzugs// gsum ga'ang zhal ras zla ba bzhin du dkar// phyag g.yas dar mdung dkar po mkha' la bsgreng*// dkar phyogs skyong zhing nag phyogs 'joms par byed// g.yon gsum nor bu bum bzang gter gyi sgrom// bsnams nas ci 'dod longs spyod char du 'bebs// sna tshogs gos dang dar dkar phod kas bklubs// shubs ldan ral gri mda' gzhu rked par btags// dbu la zhwa dkar zla ba rgyas 'dra la// zar bu dmar po g.yo mdzes tog gis spras// sag ti'i l+h+wam ldan g.yo ba'i zhabs zung gis// gom stabs stong la mkhas pa'i rab dkar rta// gzugs mchog sga srab rgyan gyis brgyan pa bcibs// lha chen gsum gyi btsun mo zla bzhin ma// gsum char yid 'phrog gos dang rin chen brgyan// ri dwags bu mo rlung gi spun zlar bcibs// lag g.yas me long gling bu mda' dar dang*// g.yon rnams nor bu gter bum nor gzhong thogs// yum chen rin spungs 'am chu'i dbang phyug ma// gnyis ka lha las babs ma thag pa bzhin// 'jo sgeg yid 'ong rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes// de dag kun kyang rang rang rigs mthun gyi// 'khor g.yog kun dang gzhan yang yul gru 'di'i// khor yug kun 'khod lha klu gnyan gyi rigs// thams cad dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis 'khod par gyur// de nas bsang mchod stob pa ni/

kye khyed rnams mthun pa'i mchod sprin 'bul ba ni// bkra shis rtags dang nyer spyod tshar du dngar// mkha' lding dbyar rnga seng ge g.yag lug ra// mdzes pa'i mig can ri dwags skad snyan bya// 'gro mgyogs theg pa 'dod 'jo bzhon ma'i rigs// rang phyogs srung ba'i go cha gzhan 'joms mtshon// rin chen gser dngul dar gos 'bru yi tshogs// dri ro nus pa phun tshogs ba lin+taḥ// shing thog dkar mngar phye mar ri bo brtsegs// ja dkar chang rgod btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil// lo 'dab phang phung g.yo ba lha yi shing*// sna tshogs dri zhim spos mchog bsregs pa'i sprin// lha lam yongs khyab 'dod yon lnga 'phro zhing*// nyams grib nyes tshogs sbyang ba'i bsang mchod 'dis// brag dkar stag rtse gnyan po mched dang gsum// 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas pa mchod do bsang*// mi gtsang thab gzhob 'khon grib phog pa rnams// na bun sangs pa'i gangs ltar dkar gyur cig /spyir du chos mdzad bcol ba'i las sgrub cing*// sgos su yul 'di'i bde legs dpal 'byor sgo// brgya phrag 'byed por zhal 'ches ltar sgrub pa'i// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha khyod bsngags par bgyi// phrin las bcol ba ni/ lha mchog thugs rje che dang pad+ma 'byung*// grub dbang nam mkha' legs nas da lta'i bar// phan pa smra ba gang dag byon pa yis// bsgos pa'i phrin las rjes su bsgrub par rigs// dkon mchog gsum po gtan gyi skyabs su zung*// 'gro la phan pa'i bsam sbyor ci yang sgrubs// chos kun rten cing 'brel 'byung tshul shes nas// sdug bsngal kun las grol 'gyur rgyal bas gsungs// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob e waṃ pa'i// lugs mchog bshad sgrub lhur len 'dus pa'i tshogs// dpag yas li khri'i chu gter g.yo 'dra yis// khyed cag bsrungs pa'i sa gzhir mdzes par mdzod// mi phyugs lus stobs bde ba 'phrog byed pa'i// nad dang mu ge 'thab rtsod mi 'byung bar// srung ba'i khongs kun phyugs 'phel lo thog legs// nor dang 'dod pa'i sde rab 'phel bar mdzod// bdag cag yon sbyor 'khor bcas gang dag tu// 'gro ba'i skyel ma 'ong ba'i bsu ba dang*// gzhi yi srung skyob byes kyi dgra lha rnams// gces pa'i bu la brtse ba'i mas bzhin mdzod// bsod nams sa gzhi yangs par 'chi med tshe'i// dpag bsam rgyas las rigs kyi lcug phran mched// longs spyod lo 'dab stug por spungs pa'i khrod// dge tshogs 'bras bu g.yur du za bar mdzod// bsang mchod mgron du bos pa thams cad kyang*// rab dga' myos pa'i ga zha 'brug ldir

bsang mchod gzhan ma 'brel ba'i tshe/ rab dga' myos pa'i gar gyis rang gnas gshegs/ zhes bsgyur na gshegs gsol du 'gyur ro// zhing*// srid zhi'i phun tshogs phywa g.yang ma lus pa// 'di na yongs 'dus shis pa'i cho ga sgrubs// zhes brjod cing gtor ma rnams yul lha'i phyogs su btang ngo*// yul lha dgyes pa'i mchod sprin 'di byas pa'i// dge bas sbyin bzhi'i pha rol legs son nas// 'bad med sems can re ba yongs skong ba// rin chen 'byung 'dra'i rgyal ba brnyes gyur cig /ces rab bkram brag dkar stag rtse mched 'khor bcas pa'i bsang mchod sprin gyi bzhad sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni gtsug lag zung gi mkhyen dpyod rnam par gsal ba'i smyug 'dzin phun tshogs chos 'phel gyis bskul ngor/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po brgyud par bcas pa'i legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa bi dza yan+tu// //maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// mdo smad dngul chu'i rgyud kyi gzhi bdag khams 'phags gnam mchongs dang dar seng 'brug rgyal gyis mtshon pa'i yul lha 'khor dang bcas pa la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga bkra shis char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgyal kun thugs rje'i mtsho las 'khrungs// phyag na pad+ma'i zla gzhon dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs btud de// yul lha dgyes pa'i bsang mchod 'dri// 'dir mdo smad dngul chu'i rgyud kyi gzhi bdag khams 'phags gnam mchongs dang dar sing 'brug rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod bya bar 'dod na/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i mchod gtor phye mar ci 'byor pa dang rtsi shing sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang la/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni/ kye rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i bla ma pad 'byung dang*// dkon mchog gsum po gtan gyi skyabs su gzung*// sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i pha rol phyin slad du// mi zad sbyin pa'i rnga chen brdung bar bgyi// bdag lhar bskyed cing mgron spyan drang ba ni/

rang nyid bsil ldan mgon po spyan ras gzigs// sna tshogs rgyan mdzes sgyu ma'i skyes bu bzhin// snang stong zung 'jug 'dzum dkar lham me ba// thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od kyi lcags kyu 'phros// dngul chu dal 'bab 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor dag /mdzes byed ri bo khams 'phags dar sing zhes// spang ljang mar gad gos gyon mtshar sdug lus// tshang tshing nags tshal skra yi len bu g.yo// 'dab ldan ri dwags bu tsha'i rtse 'jor rol// gangs brag nor bu shel gyi tog ring gi /rtse mos bdag lus dum bur phral lo zhes// dbyar skyes sprin ni 'khun sgra 'brug tu 'byin// ngo mtshar ri yi dbang po de dag dang*// khor yug 'khod pa'i ri phran grangs med du// brten par bcas pa'i zo dor mthu bo che// dkar phyogs skyong ba khams 'phags gnam mchongs dang*// dar seng 'brug rgyal gyis mtshon yul phyogs 'dir// gnas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag srid do 'tshal// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ// dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje byin rlabs dang*// bdag cag byang chub sems bskyed stobs dag gis// bshams dang sprul pa'i mchod sprin gya nom pa// mgron rnams kun gyi spyan lam 'byung gyur cig /gangs can lha gcig spyan ras gzigs dbang gis// byin rlabs zla 'od thigs pas lan brgyar phran// mthu stobs rmad byung mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs// mkhas grub du ma'i bka' dang dam tshig gis// rgyal bstan skyong bar bsgos pa'i srung ma che// lha chen khams 'phags gnam mchongs zhes bya ba// bsti gnas brgya byin khang bzang do zla can// rin chen khang brtsegs gru bzhi sgo glegs can// bya 'dabs dril chung snyan pa'i dbyangs 'jo zhing*// nor bu'i tog gi 'od 'tsher yangs pa'i khyams// phyi nang khor yug kun du lha dang mi'i// dpal 'byor mi zad gya nom snang ba'i dbus// yid 'ong nor bu brtsegs pa'i khri stengs su// dkar mdzes gzi brjid 'bar ba'i lha lus la// kā shi ras kyi thod dang rin chen gyi// rgyan gos stug pos bklubs shing lag pa dag

/yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang po yis// 'jig rten bde 'byor spel la gcig tu brel// gang de'i btsun mo yid 'phrog lus phra ma// 'dod dgu'i g.yang gi mda' dar me long dang*// nor gzhong thogs pa'i sgyu rtsal spyod ma dang*// sras dang blon 'bangs mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor// rang phyogs srung ba'i mel tshe byed pa'i tshe// rin chen sga srab spras pa'i cang shes rta// 'dod pa'i gnas kun skad cig bskor ba'i stengs// sku mdog dmar smug dar dkar la thod bcings// sder chags rgyal po gsa' yi slog pa gsol// phyag g.yas sba lcag dkar po mkha' la gdengs// cig shos dar mdung gter gyi bum pa bzung*// rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi ska rags las// mda' dang gnam rus bkang ba'i shubs ma dpyangs// rang 'khor cha lugs bzhon pa tha dad tshogs// kun kyang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i ru mtshon bsgreng*// sdang ba'i dgra dpung gzhom la chas pa'i tshe// gdong gi smin 'khyog 'dren byed khrag tu g.yo// mi phyed rdo rje'i khrab chen sku la gsol// mu tig 'od 'bar rmog gis dbu la mdzes// gang bsam gcod pa'i ral gri lag g.yas dang*// rno ba'i mdas bkang gzhu sran g.yon du bcangs// sag ti'i l+h+wam ldan g.yo ba'i zhabs gnyis kyis// rlung gi khengs pa dbrog pa'i rta la bcibs// dgra bo'i klad pa 'byin la rngam pa'i bya// khra glag bla na lding ba'i gshog sgra 'byin// stag gzig gsa' dang dom dred mang po dag /khrag gi dri mnam snga phyi kun du rgyug /sprul pa yang sprul rdo rje'i char rlung gis// mi mthun phyogs kyi sbun ma lhag med gtor// kye rin chen gzhal med khang bzangs yid 'ong nas// dar seng 'brug rgyal gnyen po sku mdog dkar// legs bris mdzod nas bton 'dra'i gos bzang dang*// rin chen rgyan phreng gser gyi rna cha g.yo// zhi zhing 'dzum pa nor bu bum bzang bsnams// rang mthun cha lugs legs pa'i 'khor dang bcas// rin chen gter dang dar zab lha mi'i dpal// bza' btung bdud rtsi'i mtsho la rtse dgas rol// rnal 'byor yul 'khor srung ba'i las byed tshe// rmig bzhi'i gom stabs mkhas pa'i rta mchog steng*// bde sogs bdag po'i gzi brjid lang tsho'i spun// sba lcag dkar po tshigs gsum lag g.yas dang*// srid pa'i rtse mor snyegs pa'i dar mdung g.yon// zla gzhon bzhu ba'i tshon gyis sbags pa lta'i// dar dkar thod dang phod ka'i lhab lhub g.yo// spu sdug 'dab chags mang po bla na lding*// sder chags gcan gzan mang po rjes su 'brang*// rang mthun cha lugs ldan pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs// dkar phyogs dga' ba'i ba dan mkha' la bsgreng*// sdang sems ldan pa'i mi srun mthong ba'i tshe// dri bzhon 'tshub ma dang 'grogs tu raṅga// spu sdug bra nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa bcibs// bzhin gyi khro gnyer rab bsdus gdong mig bsgyur// lag g.yas mdung rnon zhags pa mnga' ltar 'phen// g.yon pas lcags kyi mda' gzhu bkang ste bzung*// dbu la lcags rmog dngul chu'i mdangs su 'tsher// sku la rdo rjes gtams pa'i khrab chen gsol// steng nas bya glag mang pos gshog skor byed// snga phyir 'phar spyang mang pos mchongs stabs bsgyur// glog gi rtse dgar 'thab pa'i bzhon pa can// grangs med mtshon cha thogs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// gzhan yang g.yu brag nor bu bzang po dkar// dar mdung yid bzhin nor bus lag pa sbrel// zla gzhon snal ma thags su bskrun pa lta'i// zhwa gos kyis mdzes rta sngon steng na brjid// brag dkar mched gsum spos sku ser 'bos dang*// dbu zam dgongs 'tshal se leb nor bu dang*// a khu sde ring dpangs mtho lu gu dgyes// brag dkar stag rtse la sogs mchod 'os mgron// brag dkar bag ma bkra shis stag rtse dang*// gzi mgul rgyal mo go chen bsod nams 'bum// dngul ra shangs dkar rte ra brag rna dang*// g.yag rgyal a mye rtis ra bkra shis gnyen// gdong ma shug dil khu 'bangs brag dkar dang*// rtsa chu brag dkar gnyen po zhes bya dang*// a mye stag dgyes gzha' 'doms ris bkra dang*// lcam chen stod sde rmog cog nor bu mched// a mye bang ling nags dil stag gdong mched// brag dmar gser kha zam gdong gnyen po dang*// dngul la ri cog sku tshe bu mo spun// ra nu rgyal ba don grub ces bya ste// de dag rang rang rje blon 'bangs dang 'khor// gzhan yang ljongs 'di'i nyen skor khog yug tu// gnas pa'i yul lha sa bdag bcas pa la// so sor mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni// me tog spos dang snang byed byug pa dri// ro mchog brgya pa'i gtor ma ri ltar spungs// khyung 'brug seng ge g.yag lug ra skyes sogs// lha mi'i dpal 'byor nam mkha' mnyam pa dang*// rin chen 'bru sman dar gos sman gyi rigs// phang phung lo 'dab 'bras bus dud pa'i shing*// bsregs pa'i dud sprin sngo bsangs lha yi lam// kun khyab 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan 'dis// bsang ngo mchod do khams 'phags gnam mchongs lha// bsang ngo mchod do 'brug rgyal gnyen po dag

/rje blon btsun mo 'bangs dang bran 'khor sogs// bsang mchod mgron du gang dag lhags pa'i lha// so so'i dbang po lnga yi longs spyod du// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha yi dbang thang ltar// mkho dgu'i yo byad ma tshang med 'byung bas// dgyes rab khang bzang rtse mor phyin gyur cig /rgyal sras thugs rje che dang mtsho skyes sogs// snying rje'i bdag nyid gang dag byon rnams kyis// chos gtam yi ge dam pa snying la bris// bsgos pa'i bka' lung gnyen po dran gyis la// gzhan don bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// shin tu brling bskyed lhun po'i phrag pa ru// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i rin chen lha gnas dag /mi nyams mthon por 'degs pa'i phrin las mdzod// yul gru 'dir gnas mi dang phyugs rnams la// nad dang gdon dang dus min 'chi ba'i rigs// dgra rkun mi mthun phyogs kyis mi tshugs par// mthu stobs rdo rjes srung ba'i gur khyim mdzod// tshe yi ljon pa rgyas par bsod nams kyi// 'bras bu phun tshogs g.yur du za ba'i khrod// bde 'byor gsar pas myos pa'i ko ki las// dga' ba'i ga zha dbyangs su len par mdzod// mkha' yi bu mos sprin gyi rnga yab thogs// bdud rtsi'i char gyi thigs pa'i phreng ba sbrengs// rtswa ljang lo 'dab myu gu mañdza rīs// ri klung kun du dud pa'i dga' ston sgrubs// bdag cag yon sbyor mi dang phyugs bcas pa// gzhi byes kun du skyed byed dam ma yis// gces pa'i bu ltar nyes pa las skyob cing*// legs pa thams cad sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gang dag lhags pa'i mgron// tshim zhing dga' bas rang rang gnas su dengs// de las byung ba'i bsod nams gzhan don du// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub ched du bsngo// zhes mdo smad dngul chu'i rgyud kyi gzhi bdag gnyen po khams 'phags gnam mchongs/ dar seng 'brug rgyal gyis mtshon pa'i yul lha 'khor dang bcas pa la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga bkra shis char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di ni/

yul lha dgyes pa'i mchod sprin pa smyug 'dzin a gdon gyis bskul ngor/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa'i lugs bzang gi rjes su slob pa'i 'dun pa ma bor tsam gyi ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i tshul gyis btags ming du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bgyi bas/ grub dbang sngon mas mdzad pa'i bsang gzhung gi brjod byar byas te/ nyams su blang bde bar lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /bha wan+tu sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// mdo smad ljongs kyi dkar phyogs skyong ba'i zo dor rgyal po khro zil phram rdo rje g.yung drung 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga dge legs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i rin chen khams// sems dpa' chen po'i sgyu 'phrul zla ba'i gzugs// bsil ldan sems can sa dga'i me tog tshal// smin mdzad bla ma spyan ras gzigs la 'dud// sras bcas rgyal bas legs gsungs zil dngar rgyun// thos pa'i lus stobs rab rgyas rdzu 'phrul mthu'i// gom gcig bkod pas gser ldan dkyil 'khor che// dbang sgyur yul gyi lha chen sred med bu// 'khor bcas mos pa'i khang par mgron gnyer zhing*// cho ga'i dbyar skyes rnga gsang 'bum ldir ba'i// bsang mchod rdzogs ldan sprin sngon dkrigs pa las// dge legs char rgyun 'bebs pa'i cho ga brtsam// 'di'i bsang mchod bya bas/ rin po che'i snod du gtor ma zhal zas mtheb kyu sha ba yu mo'i rna ba lta bu bzhis rked par brgyan pa rgyan ldan la/ khyung 'brug seng ge g.yag lug ra dang ri dwags dang bya sna tshogs kyi gzugs brnyan gyis bskor ba dang*/ phye mar sogs bsang rdzas dang mchod rdzas ci 'byor spyi ltar bsham mo// de nas mgron spyan drang ba ni/

bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdo khams phyogs kyi gzhi bdag yongs kyi rgyal po khro zil phram chen po rdo rje g.yung drung mched dang btsun mo rigs sras 'khor dang yang 'khor du bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i gnas 'dir skad cig gis spyan drangs par gyur/ hrīḥ.ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ hrīḥbakra shis dge legs phun tshogs bod kyi yul// nor ldan bu mo'i rang lus sde bzhi'i dpal// 'dzad med rtag par 'jo ba'i 'byung khungs bzang*// mngon par sprul snyam mdo khams sa yi char// 'jig rten byed pos rin chen margad rdul// bsgrigs legs tshom bu tshar du dngar ba la// zla shel zhun ma'i rgyan chas bklubs 'dra ba'i// bskal pa'i gangs rdul brtsegs pa'i rab dkar ri// mi dman nga rgyal dpangs mthor snyeg pa 'dis// stong pa'i mkha' dbyings 'bigs na mi rung zhes// sprin dkar na bun stug pos nyin dang mtshan// snang ba'i sgron ma 'degs kyin blta ba snyam// de nang rin thang dpag yas nor bu'i khams// grub pa'i khang bzang lta na sdug pa'i grong*// co 'drir bzod pa dbang sngon zhun ma'i gzhir// grangs med rin chen ka gdung tshar du dngar// pha gu rtsig logs sgo dang rta babs rdzogs// sna tshogs rgyan gyi drwa ba dril chung dag /phan tshun 'thab pa'i sgra snyan glur len pas// kun nas spras pa'i gzhal med khang bzang dbus// thub mchog sras dang bcas pa'i lung rtogs bstan// rgyas par spel dang dkar po dge ba'i las// sgrub pa'i stong grogs la dga' 'dzum dmul ba// yul lha zo dor rgyal po khro zil phram// mched dang btsun mo rigs sras 'khor 'bangs bcas// rdzu 'phrul skad cig rlung gi shing rtar brten// spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ kye dwangs pa'i me long sna tshogs gzugs snang bzhin// mdun gyi sa gzhi bar snang yangs pa 'dir// lha chen rdo rje g.yung drung 'khor dang bcas// 'gog med so sor 'os pa'i gdan la bzhugs// mgron gsal gdab pa ni/

rdzu 'phrul mthu chen grub pa'i gzugs kyi sku// skad cig yid kyi 'gyur ba'i grangs mthun du// zhi drag las kyi rnam 'gyur mtha' klas phyir// mtha' gcig mchel ba blo ldan gad mo'i rgyu// 'on te sngon byung dam pa'i gsung don bcud// rjod byed phreng du bstar ba 'di lta ste// 'od 'bar gser gyi pa tra 'khyug pa'i gseng*// sna tshogs nor bu'i phra tshom spras pa'i khrir// 'jam zhing bde ster dar zab gdan gyi steng*// lha yi dge bsnyen rdo rje g.yung drung ni// bla gzhon bye ba'i mdzes sdug byed po yis// gcig tu spungs lta'i dkar 'tsher mig gi dpyid// khro 'dzum dpa' ba'i nyams ldan dar bab skur// skabs gsum dbang pos spyad 'os dar dkar gyi// gos bzang ston ka'i sprin dkar g.yo 'dra dang*// kā shi ka yi ras bzang thod du bcings// yul 'khor 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor spel ba'i slad// phyag gnyis yid bzhin nor bu bum bzang bsnams// nyi gzhon la 'khu gser gyi rna cha sogs// rin chen rgyan phreng mang pos kun nas mdzes// 'khor du lang tsho'i zhags pas skye 'gro yi// snying gi ri dwags 'ching ba'i btsun mo sras// dpa' mdzangs 'phrul gyi blon pos bskor ba'i dbus// gya nom 'dod pa'i yon tan dgyes dgur rtsen// rang phyogs srung ba'i mel tsher rgyu ba'am// gnod byed sdang dgra gzhom la chas pa'i tshe// myur mgyogs bskyod pa'i gom stabs stong phrag mkhan// mtshams sprin gsar pa g.yo ba lta bu'i rta// rin chen sga srab rgyan gyis spras pa'i steng*// sag ti'i l+h+wam gyis sgeg pa'i zhabs zung rol// dar dkar ber dang dngul gyi khrab rmog dag /mu tig dkar po'i 'od 'tsher sku la spras// dgra bo'i snying 'bigs mda' dang gnam ru yis// mngon par gtams pa'i stag dong gzig shubs dang*// rno ngar phun tshogs ral gri rked la gzir// phyag g.yas sba lcag dkar po tshigs gsum dang*// g.yon pas dar mdung dkar po mkha' la bsgrengs// g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab kun du rtsal chen gyi// skyes bu go mtshon thogs pa grangs med dang*// gtum chen khra rgod lding ba'i gshog sgra 'byin// stag dang seng ge'i sgeg mos mchongs stabs bsgyur// g.yag rgod ngar zhing rta mchog lhang lhang btser// lha chen rigs sras zhul yag zhul phran mched// lha lus ltar mdzes zla gzhon zhal ras 'dzum// legs bris dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub dang*// ras dkar dri med shel gyi lwa thod bcings// 'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor bu lag na bsnams// sdang byed dgra bo gzhom la chas pa na// rmig bzhis gom stabs rlung gi bgrod pa yang*// shin tu dal bur bgyid pa'i cang shes steng*// rang nyid srung ba'i sra mkhregs go cha bgos// gzhan phyogs 'joms pa'i 'khor gsum sked la btags// dar mdung dkar po srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs// rigs mthun gnyan dmag 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bskor// gnyan gyi sras chung dmag dpon dgra 'dul ni// kim shu ka dpal sdang ba'i dmar mdangs can// khro chags nyams kyi mdzes pa ci yang ston// stag lpags gsar pa'i zhwa dang gos kyis brgyan// mtsho sman ne'u sing mi nyag stag mgo dang*// mgron bu mched sogs 'khor gyis kun nas bskor// zhe sdang chang myos dgra bo mthong ba'i tshe// smin ma rab 'khyog sdang mig dmar por bsgyur// dgra bo'i bla nas 'bod pa'i nga ro sgrogs// bdud rta nag po rting dkar zhabs su bcibs// sku la dar dmar 'thab ber bgos pa'i steng*// rdo rje'i byang bu gshibs pa'i go khrab dang*// ba dan rgod 'phrus brgyan pa'i rmog zhu gsol// phyag gnyis mda' dang gzhu sbyar lcags kyus mdzes// reg pa gcod byed ral gri rked par gzir// btsan dang bdud kyi dmag tshogs dgra la 'gyed// zil phram gnyen gyi btsun mo rgod lcam dang*// mu tig shel sman mo dang 'od bzang sman// ngang yag lha mo bo sdad 'dzum mkhas rnams// lag na mngon shes 'phrul gyi me long dang*// mi zad 'dod dgu'i gter bkang gzhong pa thogs// dar dkar gos dang rin chen rgyan phreng bklubs// 'jo sgeg lang tsho dar bab zur mig gis// khengs ldan snying gi brtan pa rang dbang phrogs// rang phyogs srung ba'i bya rar rgyu ba'i tshe// sha ba'i bu mo rkyang ser rta la chibs// lha klu gnyan gyi bu mo'i 'khor tshogs bcas// gang bsam gnas su skad cig bskor bzod cing*// gnod byed phyogs su yams kyi ser char 'bebs// gzhan yang zil phram gnyan gyi bka' 'khor du// sna tshogs las kyi gtsug lag de dang der// rnam par sgrin pa'i blo dang nus pa'i mthu// dpa' rtsal thogs med 'khor tshogs bgrang yas rnams// ljongs kyi thig le'i nyen kor 'khor yug gi

/'dod dgu 'byung ba'i chu gter chu mig dang*// gangs ri spang ri brag ri nags tshal klung*// brten par bcas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag bcas// rang rang cha lugs kyis spras 'khod par gyur// bshams pa'i gtor ma yod na/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma lha'i zhal zas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun tshogs pa 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bh+rū mi pa ti badz+ra shā shwa ta sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥsar+b+ba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ gtor ma med pa'i tshe mi dgos so// yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ chos dbyings 'pho 'gyur dben pa'i bden pa dang*// chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med bden pa'i mthus// bshams dang sprul pa'i mchod sprin sgyu ma'i 'phrul// mchod yul kun gyi spyan lam 'byung gyur cig /mchod rdzas 'bul ba ni/ kye khyed rnams dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas 'bul ba ni// yid 'ong gzugs mchog snyan 'jebs rol mo'i sgra// zhim pa'i dri bsung ro drug bcud kyi zas// sna tshogs dar gos brgya byin tshon ltar bkra// shis pa'i rtags brgyad mi dbang rin chen bdun// ci 'dod re skong dpag bsam bum pa bzang*// spu sdug gom stabs mkhas pa'i rta mchog dang*// g.yag lug ra skyes 'dod 'jo bzhon ma'i rigs// rigs mthun khyu nang rtse ba'i ri dwags rnams// gzugs mdzes mig gi ut+pal phyogs su g.yo// 'dab bzang dbang po khyu byug bya rgod sogs// 'phur lding mkha' la bsgyur mkhas du ma dang*// gdong lnga pa dang stag gzig dom dred kyis// nyer mtshon mche sder rno ba'i khengs ldan rigs// 'dod dgu 'dzad med 'byung ba'i gtor ma dang*// dkar mngar phye mar ri bo'i spo dang mnyam// ja bzang chang gi btung ba'i chu gter 'khyil// lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i// dbyar skyes gzhon nu spos dang lhan cig nyid// bsregs pa'i dud sprin nyes pa kun sbyangs shing*// 'dod pa'i yon tan rtag 'jo'i mchod sprin 'dis// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i zo dor yongs kyi rje// zil phram rdo rje g.yung drung bsang zhing mchod// sras dang btsun mor gtogs pa bsang zhing mchod// ma sring bka' yi 'phrul blon bsang zhing mchod// bran dang yang bran bcas pa bsang zhing mchod// deng 'dir mchod pa'i mgron du gnyer ro cog

/ci 'dod 'dzad med dpal la spyod gyur cig /phrin las gzhol ba ni/ kye lha gcig thugs rje che dang mtsho skyes zhabs// ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rim byon gyis// mthun pa'i rdzas dang mchod sbyin gtor mas brngan// ji skad bsgos pa'i nor bu snying la chongs// bslu med dkon mchog gsum po skyabs su zung*// 'gro la snying brtse byang chub sems mchog skyed// chos rnams rang bzhin spros dang bral shes na// sdug bsngal kun las grol 'gyur rgyal bas gsungs// kun dga'i 'byung gnas skal bzang rgyal ba'i bstan// bshad dang sgrub pa lhur len 'dus pa'i tshon// thun mtshams dmar 'od sar pa'i dge mtshan gyis// khyed cag bsrungs pa'i sa stengs mdzes par mdzod// sngo bsangs dbyar dus sprin gyi rnga yab kyis// bdud rtsi'i char rgyun then zhod 'tsham par sbreng*// dbyar skyes sdong bu lo 'dab bskyed bsrings rtser// 'bru bcud dpal 'phel snod kyi dge legs stsol// bdag cag yon sbyor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// bsod nams sa gzhir dpal 'byor chu gter 'khyil// ring 'tsho'i lhun po ches brling phrag pa'i gong*// dge spyod lha gnas 'degs pa'i stong grogs mdzod// gzhir sdod byes su bgrod pa'i gnas skabs kun// dgra rkun nyes phyogs kun las bsrung ba dang*// gzhi bzung so nam mdun gros khe spogs sogs// legs dpal brgya dang phrad pa'i stong grogs mdzod// bde rgyu rnam dkar dge bcu sgrub pa dang*// bde 'byung rnam 'dren bstan pa'i thos bsam bsgom// bde 'dod gang gis bsgrub la gegs med cing*// bde gshegs bstan par phan pa'i stong grogs mdzod// phyogs bral zhing gi 'dab stong dga' tshal nas// chos srid 'byor pa'i phywa g.yang phun tshogs rnams// mthu stobs bung ba'i rtsal gyis tshur bsdus la// sbyin bdag bde 'byor mnga' thang dar bar mdzod// dgyes bskyed sbyin pa'i rnga chen brdungs nas ni// dgyes 'gyur mchod pa'i gnas 'dir bos so 'tshal// dgyes 'dzum zla 'od gsar pa spro byed kyin// dgyes pa'i gar gyis kha 'dzin rgyab brten mdzod// bsang mchod gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe/

dgyes pa'i gar gyis rang gnas dengs shig gu// zhes gshegs su gsol ba'i tshig tu bsgyur bas grub bo// zhes mdo smad ljongs kyi dkar phyogs skyong ba'i zo dor yongs kyi rgyal po khro zil phram rdo rje g.yung drung 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga dge legs char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer slob bu lhun grub phun tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor nyang gi gter byon dang mtsho skyes zhabs kyis mdzad par grags pa'i yig rnying las bshad pa'i 'khor tshogs rags bsdus kyi kha 'gengs kyis cung zad spel ba dang bcas te/ rje btsun e waṃ pa'i ring lugs kyi rjes su slob pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i 'bru mang gi gnam lo shar ba'i chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes 'chi med bla ma rgyal sar phebs pa'i 'grub spyod yod pa'i nyin sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu grub par bgyis pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// bla ma lhag pa'i lha la gus btud de// srid pa'i mgron rigs lha bu grangs med dag /mchod chog legs bris 'dun sar nyer bkug nas// bsang rdzas dpal gyi dga' ston ci yang stob// 'dir jo bo bag seng gi bsang mchod bya bas/ bsang rdzas ci 'byor pa bshams/ spyi bsang rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du btang nas 'di skad gyer ro// kye 'bri klung dal gyis 'bab ma'i 'gram ngogs su// bkod legs ri bo phreng du bstar ba'i dbus// bag seng zhes bya'i sa 'dzin dbang po ni// byed pos margad phung po spungs 'dra'i rtser// shel dkar dbang sngon brag ri brtsegs pa'i nang*// legs bris khang bzang sa la 'phos snyam nas// jo bo bag seng gnyen pos nyer mtshon pa'i// ljongs kyi 'khor yug mnga' sgyur gzhi yi bdag /'khor du bcas pa gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// skad cig nyid du tshur byon brtan par bzhugs// zhes pas spyan drangs/

mgron gsal btab nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ kye jo bo bag seng gnyen po zhes bya ba// sku yi rnam 'phrul 'gro sems skad cig ma'i// grangs dang mnyam pa'i sprul bsgyur mtha' yas kyang*// rang phyogs srung dang dpal 'byor bskyed pa'i tshe// ston zla rgyas pa lta bu'i bzhin ras 'dzum// rab dkar kā shi'i ras kyi 'jol ber dang*// mu tig phreng dang dar gyi lhab lhub mdzes// nor bu gter gyi bum pas phyag srung brel// bstan pa bsrung dang rnal 'byor bsgo ba'i las// mngon par sgrub cing mel tsher chas pa'i tshe// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum zhing khro ba'i nyams// sku la dar dkar gos dang dngul khrab gsol// mu tig 'od 'tsher rmog dkar dbu la gyon// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin yid bzhin nor bu yis// srid pa'i dpal 'byor dbang du sdud cing spel// g.yon pas dkar po'i phyogs su dga' ba'i brdar// mdung dar dkar po srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs// dgra srog gcod pa'i 'khor gsum sked par bskor// gang bsams gnas su bgrod pa'i rdzu 'phrul rta// gom stabs mkhas pa kai la sha yi spun// rin chen sga srab mchog gis spras pa'i steng*// sag ti'i l+h+wam gyis sgeg pa'i zhabs zung rol// sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang g.yog bcas pa'i// mi dpa' rta mgyogs mang po snga phyir rgyu// mdun du gnas bdag dmar po btsan
